Women and Child Development.note: Main categories with null go straight to the description box (2000 chars). Anganwadi is run by the state: try State Government (AP/TS) first; use this ministry route for scheme-level problems or when the state does not act.

app_map.food (anganwadi part): Government Schemes Related/ Welfare Programs > pick the Anganwadi line that matches (building/staff/funds, nutrition food, preschool, Poshan Tracker data)

Women and Child Development.out_of_scope_for_app: NCW and crime categories are personal/police matters; the app does not take these reports and must point to 181 women helpline / 112 / 1098 instead.
